title: Research Gap Finder — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Identifies questions that existing studies may not resolve. The Research Gap Finder identifies questions that existing studies may not resolve. It compares the findings across a set of papers, maps what each one covered, and highlights the unanswered questions: populations not studied, methods not tried, contradictions never resolved, and time periods not covered. Each gap becomes a candidate research direction.
capabilities: Map what each paper in a set covered
Find unstudied populations and settings
Spot methods never tried on the question
Surface contradictions never resolved
Turn gaps into candidate research directions
